thesis: New effective regularities can arise from fixed local mechanisms without new fundamental rules.
role: Make emergence precise through collective descriptions and their limits.

ideas.statement: Diffusion and scale transformations show how mechanisms, variables and justified approximations produce autonomous effective regularities.
Rule simplicity must include initial-state information, while weak emergence and strong ontological emergence are distinct.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Formal universality does not establish a cellular-automaton universe, and emergence does not explain why anything exists.
